newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton firms on mixed buying, spreads active.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton firms on mixed buying, spreads active.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were higher at midday with early activity focused on the nearby switch and on speculative rolling in the March contract, floor sources said.
They said prices were consolidating following five consecutive days of losses, with speculative and trade buying noted in the March contract.
"There is a little more optimism because the market is up and people feel it might go higher," Ernest Simon, a cotton specialist with Prudential Securities, said.
Local and fund selling was keeping March below resistance at 74.00 cents, Simon added.
Support was pegged at 73.00 cents in March.
At 1150 EST, the spot month was 0.50 cent per lb higher at 73.60 cents, traded 73.70 to 73.49 cents.
